evals.prompt: Audita el Brand Studio completo. Quiero saber qué gaps tiene para que el SDR pueda vender con la marca.
evals.expected_output: Audit report with CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM findings covering brand schema, extraction prompts, and SDR readiness. Should apply Aaker, Keller, Gad, Neumeier as primary frameworks. Must include methodology coverage matrix and SDR readiness score.

assertions.text: Output contains the required report sections: Executive Summary, Findings (with severity levels), Methodology Coverage Matrix, and SDR Readiness Score
Findings are categorized as CRITICAL, HIGH, or MEDIUM with specific items under each
References at least 4 of the 6 primary brand frameworks: Aaker, Keller, Gad, Neumeier, Brand Love Key, StoryBrand
Cites real file paths, field names, and model structures from the codebase
Identifies at least 3 genuine gaps in the brand schema
Includes an SDR readiness evaluation table
Recommendations name exact files, fields, and changes

evals.prompt: Audita el tipo de oferta COHORT_BASED_COURSE. Tenemos varios cursos en cohorte y quiero asegurarme de que el sistema captura todo lo que necesita el SDR para vender este tipo de programa.
evals.expected_output: Type-specific audit for COHORT_BASED_COURSE with Hormozi/WbD/Casel as primary frameworks. Must examine ProgramDetails and include Product Blueprint validation.

assertions.text: Focuses on COHORT_BASED_COURSE, mentioning ProgramDetails, curriculum, cohort_limit, schedule
Analyzes ProgramDetails model including curriculum, schedule, cohort settings, community
Applies Hormozi, WbD, and Casel as primary — not primarily brand-level frameworks
Validates complete Product Blueprint: Target/ICP, Critical Event, Promise, Process, Guarantee
Includes program-specific SDR questions: duration, start date, waitlist, curriculum, live interaction
Checks brand-to-offer data inheritance (voice, story, positioning, proof)

evals.prompt: Revisa los prompts de extracción del Brand Studio. Quiero saber si cuando extraemos la marca de un sitio web, los prompts capturan la información al nivel atómico correcto o si producen datos demasiado genéricos.
evals.expected_output: Prompt-by-prompt analysis of all brand_extract_*.j2 templates evaluating specificity, framework alignment, and translation quality.

assertions.text: Evaluates specific vs generic output with concrete examples
Cross-references each prompt against its target framework
Identifies concrete weaknesses in at least 3 prompts
Evaluates plain language vs methodology jargon mapping
